cases.sentence: В девятом ___, в десятый день десятого месяца, было ко мне слово Господа.
cases.translation: In the ninth year, on the tenth day of the tenth month, the word of the Lord came to me.
cases.explain: The preposition 'в' (in) with time expressions requires the prepositional case.

cases.translation: Tell this rebellious house a parable.
cases.explain: The verb 'поведай' (tell) with indirect object governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Брось в него мясо, хорошее ___, окорок и лопатку.
cases.translation: Put meat, good meat, a thigh and a shoulder into it.
cases.explain: Direct object of the verb 'брось' (throw) takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Жители его пролили кровь у всех на ___.
cases.translation: The inhabitants poured out blood before all.
cases.explain: The preposition 'на' (before) can govern the dative when expressing position; here 'на виду' means 'in sight.'

cases.sentence: Ты будешь судим по твоим путям и ___, возвещает владыка Господь.
cases.translation: You will be judged according to your ways and deeds, declares the Lord God.
cases.explain: The preposition 'по' (according to) governing parallel nouns requires the dative case.

cases.sentence: Было ко мне слово Господа в день, когда я отниму у тебя усладу глаз твоих, но не скорби, не сетуй и не проливай ___.
cases.translation: The word of the Lord came to me on the day I take from you the desire of your eyes, but do not mourn, do not weep, and do not shed tears.
cases.explain: The verb 'проливать' (to shed) with plural direct object requires the accusative, which for feminine nouns matches the genitive plural.

cases.sentence: И Закииль будет вам знаменем, вы будете делать так, как делал он, когда это сбудется, вы узнаете, что я ___.
cases.translation: And Ezekiel will be a sign to you; you will do as he did, when this comes to pass, you will know that I am the Lord.
cases.explain: The predicate nominative after the verb 'быть' (to be) takes the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Смерть жены Иезекииля Было ко мне слово Господа. Сын человеческий, я одним ударом отниму у тебя усладу глаз твоих, твоей драгоценной ___, но не скорби.
cases.translation: The wife of Ezekiel: The word of the Lord came to me. Son of man, I will take from you the desire of your eyes, your precious wife, but do not mourn.
cases.explain: Possession is expressed by the genitive case, as 'the desire of your eyes.'

reading.ru: Сын человеческий, запиши этот день, сегодняшний день, потому что царь Вавилона в этот день осадил Иерусалим.
reading.question: Why was Ezekiel told to write down this specific day?
options: Because the king of Babylon was laying siege to Jerusalem on that day
Because it was the beginning of the Jewish New Year
Because Ezekiel's wife was about to die
Because God wanted him to start writing a new book
reading.correct: Because the king of Babylon was laying siege to Jerusalem on that day
reading.explain: The text states: 'запиши этот день... потому что царь Вавилона в этот день осадил Иерусалим' — write this day because the king of Babylon was laying siege to Jerusalem on that day.

reading.ru: Поставь котел, поставь и налей воды.
reading.question: What does God command Ezekiel to tell the house about?
options: Put a cauldron on the fire and pour water into it
Gather the finest sheep for a sacrifice
Prepare mourning clothes for a funeral
Build a wall around the city
reading.correct: Put a cauldron on the fire and pour water into it
reading.explain: The text directly states: 'Поставь котел, поставь и налей воды' — Put a cauldron, put it on, and pour water into it.

reading.ru: Утром я говорил с народом, а вечером у меня умерла жена.
reading.question: When did Ezekiel's wife die?
options: In the evening of the day he spoke to the people
Three days after he spoke to the people
In the middle of the night
reading.correct: In the evening of the day he spoke to the people
reading.explain: The verse states: 'Утром я говорил с народом, а вечером у меня умерла жена' — In the morning I spoke to the people, and in the evening my wife died.

reading.ru: Тогда люди спросили меня, «Не скажешь ли, какое значение для нас в том, что ты делаешь?»
reading.question: What did the people ask Ezekiel?
options: What is the meaning of your actions for us?
Why did your wife have to die?
When will the siege of Jerusalem end?
How did you become a prophet?
reading.correct: What is the meaning of your actions for us?
reading.explain: The text says: 'Не скажешь ли, какое значение для нас в том, что ты делаешь?' — Will you not tell us what meaning your actions have for us?

reading.ru: Я оскверню свое святилище, крепость, которой вы гордитесь, усладу глаз ваших.
reading.question: What does God say he will profane?
options: His sanctuary, the pride of your power, the desire of your eyes
reading.correct: His sanctuary, the pride of your power, the desire of your eyes
reading.explain: God declares: 'Я оскверню свое святилище, крепость, которой вы гордитесь, усладу глаз ваших' — I will profane my sanctuary, the fortress of which you are proud, the desire of your eyes.

reading.ru: В тот самый день придет уцелевший, чтобы рассказать тебе новости.
reading.question: Who will come to Ezekiel on that day to bring news?
options: A survivor to tell him news
reading.correct: A survivor to tell him news
reading.explain: The text states: 'придет уцелевший, чтобы рассказать тебе новости' — a survivor will come to tell you news.
